description: Stop the recording and write the MP4. Returns the file, duration in seconds, size and chapters. With music: true, mixes a ducked music bed under the video and writes a credits JSON next to it (credit the track where you publish).

music.description: Mix a music bed under the video (default false). Needs python3, ffmpeg and ffprobe; picks a track from Jamendo unless SHIPVO_MUSIC_FILE is set.

narration.description: Path to a wav with a voice track. It is mixed over the video, trimmed to the video length (the result says so), and ducks the music when music is true.

name: record_stop
